name: X Hygiene
tagline: Audits your followers, prices the cleanup, then lists who to cut
description: Reviews the accounts that follow you and the ones you follow back, and tells you the price of the cleanup before any of it happens. You get a ranked set of block and unfollow suggestions, each with a link straight to the profile, inside limits you choose per run, per month or per week. It acts on nothing itself.
author: bradshannon
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
